text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and self-awareness. First, time management is essential: create a realistic schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on what matters most, so you finish important work before minor details. Third, scope management means being honest about what you can realistically do, and reducing tasks if necessary. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem, tell your manager or team early instead of waiting until the last minute. By combining these four skills, you can reduce stress, meet deadlines more reliably, and produce better work.
